newsitem.title: UK: McDonnell Douglas on track for '96 earnings.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas on track for '96 earnings.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas chairman Harry Stonecipher said the defence giant's 1996 full year earnings were set to meet analysts forecasts and would be sharply up from when he last came to Farnborough two years ago.
"If we do as well in the second half of this year as we did in the first, and we expect to do so, we will earn about 200 million more dollars than we did in 1994," he told a news conference.

"That is consistent with analysts' estimates of our 1996 earnings," he added, and noted that the company share price is now trading at around $50 a share, compared to $20 two years ago, adjusted for share splits.
